summary: This filing is a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a routine debt issuance by HSBC Holdings plc, a savings institution. The offering consists of $2.25 billion in 4.711% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2030 and $2.25 billion in 5.208% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2034, representing a standard financing transaction. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring; it is purely a capital-raising exercise under an existing shelf registration (No. 333-277306). As an ordinary issuer filing, it does not meet the criteria for classification as a special situation.
